review_evidence: README explicitly documents verified properties: compilation cannot throw, compiled NFA transitions are valid, bounded backtracking terminates, and matches are slices of the original string.
32 of 62 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including Compiler.Lemmas.compile_eq_ok, NFA validity lemmas, backtracking well-foundedness/termination measures, and slice-validity facts.
The implementation therefore carries substantive checked compiler/execution correctness content rather than being only a utility library.
summary: Reviewed regex; retain its verified regular-expression compiler and bounded-backtracking engine.

review_evidence: AddState.lean: 929 lines of @[spec] theorems for push, add_match, add_union, c_range, c_possessive, c_lookaround_*, c_repetition_*, greedy_union, c_at_least_* with pre/post conditions
Basic.lean: Foundational defs (isAppend, tRefLt, stateIdNextOfLt, cValid, cMemAndValid) and coercion lemmas between StateT/EStateM/CompilerM monads
Compile.lean: Main c_compile_spec theorem and mutual recursion proofs for c_alt_iter_fold, c_concat_fold, c_bounded, c_lookaround, c_repetition, c_exactly, c_concat, c_cap with termination_by
Patch.lean: patchAssignable, patch2Assignable, assignableIf defs and patch/patch2 spec theorems with lift specifications
Grammar/Basic.lean: Parser combinators (loop with termination_by, StateT.efoldlP, manyM, tryChar, withPos) with formal semantics
Grammar/Grammar.lean: Full PCRE2 parser producing Syntax trees — escape sequences, char classes, groups, repetitions, assertions, backrefs, unicode properties
Translate.lean: AST-to-HIR visitor with Translator state, flag merging, visit_pre/visit_post/class set ops, pop_concat_exprs/pop_alt_exprs with termination_by
Unicode.lean: rangesOfGeneralCategory, rangesOfProperty, case_fold_char, case_fold_range with loop termination proof, is_word_char
summary: All 8 files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. The files collectively form a formally verified regex compiler with: (1) Compiler verification lemmas (AddState.lean, Basic.lean, Compile.lean, Patch.lean) using @[spec] annotations for pre/post conditions, well-founded recursion, and monadic coercion proofs; (2) A formal PCRE2 grammar parser (Grammar/Basic.lean, Grammar/Grammar.lean) with parser combinators, termination proofs, and semantic actions producing Lean Syntax trees; (3) AST-to-HIR translation (Translate.lean) with visitor pattern, stack-based state management, and termination proofs; (4) Unicode property support (Unicode.lean) with formal character class operations and case folding. No file is a pure import aggregator or lacks formal content.
